chunks: Ibn Mahbub, from 'Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Abi al-Ward, who said:
I asked Aba Ja'far عليه السلام about a man who killed a slave by mistake. He said: “Its value is upon him, and its value is not to exceed ten thousand dirhams.”

I said: And who assesses his value when he is dead? He said: “If his master has witnesses that his value on the day he was killed was such-and-such, his killer is charged according to it. But if he has no witnesses for that, then the valuation rests with the one who killed him together with his oath, swearing by Allah that he has no value greater than what I have assessed for him. If he refuses to swear and returns the oath to the master, then if the master swears, he is given what he swore to, and his value is not to exceed ten thousand dirhams.”
He said: “And if the slave was a believer and he killed him deliberately, he must pay his value, free a slave, fast two consecutive months, and repent to Allah, Mighty and Majestic.”

key_terms.خَطَأً: by mistake; accidental killing rather than intentional homicide
key_terms.رَقَبَةً: a slave to be freed as expiation
key_terms.شُهُودٌ: witnesses who testify to the slave’s value
key_terms.عَبْدًا: a slave whose killing is the subject of the ruling
key_terms.قِيمَتُهُ: his monetary value, payable as compensation
key_terms.مُؤْمِنًا: a believer; here specifying the slave’s faith-status
key_terms.مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ: consecutively, describing the required two-month fast
key_terms.يَمِينِهِ: his oath, used in determining value when witnesses are absent

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone kills a slave by mistake or deliberately in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith sets out the legal ruling for one who kills a slave by mistake, requiring payment of the slave’s assessed value up to a maximum of ten thousand dirhams, with procedures for valuation through witnesses or oath. It also states that if a believing slave is killed deliberately, the killer must pay the value, perform expiation by freeing a slave and fasting two consecutive months, and repent to Allah, Mighty and Majestic.
